The <b>Sprintmaster Memento</b> is a [[Materium#Mementos|Memento]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
The memento can be displayed on a shelf in the [[Bellhome]] after interacting with the desk.

It appears in the middle-right slot of the shelving.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bellhome.png!Location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Bellhart 09.png!Displayed inside Bellhome in Bellhart
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Given by [[Sprintmaster Swift]] in [[Far Fields]] after beating him four times in his races. Sprintmaster Swift only offers the fourth race after [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] has acquired the [[Everbloom]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Sprintmaster Swift 01.png!Location of Sprintmaster Swift in Far Fields
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Sprintmaster Swift 01.png!Sprintmaster Swift in Far Fields
}}
